{{Top|leg}}
'''Maneuver 717''' was the codename given by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to a mission designed to eliminate a possible [[Spy/Legends|spy]] or enemy agent posing as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in a given squad. During a routine mission, the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] would give the order to fly "Maneuver 717" and the loyal pilots would allow the suspected spy to head the squad. Once the spy was unable to see the other [[Starship/Legends|ships]], they would fire on the spy and destroy his or her ship. It would later be claimed that the spy had been cut down by enemy fire.
